subject: Request: temporary invoice-only pilot / no-PO onboarding - Novus Data
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novusdata.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary no-PO path for pilot - Novus Data

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the demo this week — excited by the latency improvements Redwood was showing. We're trying to move a short pilot forward quickly (3 months, small usage capped at $2,500/month) and I wanted to check whether Novus can be onboarded without issuing a purchase order for the initial pilot phase.

Our procurement team prefers to issue POs but given the speed we need, they'd accept an invoice-only approach for the first 60–90 days if Redwood can accept standard Net30 terms and provide an SOW. We'll provide the completed onboarding form and W-9.

Attached: Novus_Onboarding_Form.pdf, SOW-v2.docx

Can you let me know what documentation you need from our side and whether a temporary no-PO path is possible? If not, any suggestions on an expedited PO gating process would be helpful.

Appreciate it,
Alex Turner
Head of Platform Partnerships
Novus Data
procurement@novusdata.com

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@novusdata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 11:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary no-PO path for pilot - Novus Data

Alex — thanks for the note and for sending the form + SOW. We can be flexible for short pilots but we have a standard set of controls we need to verify before agreeing to invoice-only onboarding. To move quickly, please do the following: 

- Confirm the pilot cap ($2,500 / month) in the final SOW and add an explicit stop clause when the threshold is reached.
- Send completed vendor profile + W-9 (I see Novus_Onboarding_Form.pdf attached).
- Confirm billing contact and remit-to address for invoices.

I'll loop in Finance/Procurement internally to confirm temporary invoice-only routing. Marissa (Finance) and Karthik (Legal/Procurement) are CC'd to evaluate the risk and thresholds. My expectation: we can approve a timeboxed invoice-only path for up to 90 days or until cumulative spend reaches $7,500, whichever comes first, subject to the checks above.

Next steps from our side: we will run a quick risk check and confirm any additional contract language (minimal SOW addendum). If approved, invoices should be sent to billing@redwood.com with PO field left blank and reference NOVUS-2027-PILOT-01.

I'll follow up with internal notes by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 6 Jun 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: Novus invoice-only pilot - risk & thresholds

Hannah / Karthik — quick internal note based on Alex's ask and the SOW he attached.

On Fri, 5 Jun 2027 at 11:14 AM, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com> wrote:
> I'll loop in Finance/Procurement internally to confirm temporary invoice-only routing.

My read: small-dollar pilot, known company, buyer references look OK. Proposed internal guardrails:

- Approve invoice-only onboarding for a timeboxed 90-day pilot, capped at $7,500 total (equivalent to $2,500/mo).
- Require completed vendor profile + W-9 before first invoice.
- Require a signed SOW with explicit cap + cancellation clause.
- No product access escalation (no provisioning beyond pilot users) until vendor is PO-approved in our system.
- If any invoice exceeds $2,500 in a single month or cumulative exceeds $7,500, procurement will block further invoices and request a PO.

Karthik — anything else from a legal/procurement perspective (insurance, AML screening)?

Attachment: risk-evaluation-notes.txt

Marissa
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@novusdata.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary no-PO path for pilot - Novus Data

All — looping Alex back with our decision and a short list of conditions.

On Sat, 6 Jun 2027 at 09:07 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Proposed internal guardrails: approve invoice-only onboarding for a timeboxed 90-day pilot, capped at $7,500 total.

Thanks everyone — this looks fine to me with one addition: require proof of basic insurance (general liability) or a statement that they are self-insured for small pilots. Also confirm that the SOW includes the spend cap and an explicit termination/stop clause. Once those are received, Finance will accept invoices on Net30 with the PO field blank and route them to billing@redwood.com.

Alex — Hannah will be your point person. To summarize the conditional approval:

- We can onboard Novus on an invoice-only path for a 90-day pilot (ends automatically at day 90) or until cumulative spend hits $7,500.
- Required before first invoice: completed vendor profile (we have Novus_Onboarding_Form.pdf), signed SOW with cap + stop clause, W-9, and either confirmation of general liability insurance or an insurance waiver statement for the pilot.
- Invoice instructions: send to billing@redwood.com, reference NOVUS-2027-PILOT-01; Net30 terms.

Please let us know if you can provide the insurance confirmation and the signed SOW this week; once we have them we'll confirm the temporary routing.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Legal Counsel (Procurement)
Redwood Inference
